answer: Suppose agent identities must post a bond before they can submit jobs to a shared marketplace. The protocol limits each bond to one active identity at a time and slashes it when an identity is caught laundering rewards through colluding accounts. An attacker can still create many keys, but each useful identity ties up capital, while detected abuse destroys part of it. The orchard may welcome new agents, yet the lagoon’s signal is costly to fake: making a Sybil swarm influential requires funding it and risking that stake.
